reason: What I run now does the job well enough. I know where everything is and the drivers know it too. Close to four hundred a month, or about two-sixty with the discount, is another bill on top of fuel, insurance and wages, just to fix problems I mostly don't have.
objection: It's a brand-new company with no customers. I'd be moving my bookings and driver records onto something nobody has tested on a real fleet, and if they fold in a year I'm left with an Excel export and a lot of re-learning.
would_change_my_mind: An operator my size that I know from the bus association meetings telling me it caught a double-booking or an expired authority for them and saved them real money or an audit headache.
